status: Phase 13.4 Storage Remediation Design Complete — Implementation Pending

CONT-08.title: Worker init-uploads uses root + chmod 777
CONT-08.root_cause: K8s CSI mounts volume root as root:root (0755), blocking non-root UID 1000 without fsGroup.
CONT-08.latent_bug: init-uploads omitted from ai-service; ai-service fails readiness probe if started before worker.

ARCH-08.title: Uploads PVC is RWO with dual consumer Deployments and HPA (max 3)
ARCH-08.root_cause: RWO prevents multi-node attachment under cloud block storage CSI drivers.

kubernetes_deployment_target.cloud_target_status: Documented as external requirement requiring provisioner substitution

storage_class_verification.changing_access_mode_to_rwx_effect: Fails on cloud block storage; unsupported by local-path across nodes

hpa_scheduler_interaction.risk: Multi-Attach error if worker replicas or ai-service schedule across different nodes

architecture_A_rwo_fsgroup_colocation.name: RWO + fsGroup + PodAffinity Co-Location
architecture_A_rwo_fsgroup_colocation.k8s_changes: Add fsGroup: 1000 to ai-service and worker; add podAffinity to worker
architecture_A_rwo_fsgroup_colocation.suitability: Valid for local dev and single-node clusters

architecture_B_rwx_fsgroup.name: RWX Shared Filesystem + fsGroup
architecture_B_rwx_fsgroup.k8s_changes: Change PVC to RWX; update StorageClass; add fsGroup: 1000
architecture_B_rwx_fsgroup.suitability: Standard cloud pattern with managed NFS (EFS/Filestore)

architecture_C_object_storage.name: Object Storage (S3/GCS/MinIO)
architecture_C_object_storage.k8s_changes: Remove PVC and volume mounts entirely

fsgroup_verification.local_path_compatibility: Fully compatible via kubelet native volume ownership management

safe_scope_determination.selected_option: Option 1 (Remediate CONT-08 permissions via fsGroup; co-locate worker via podAffinity; document ARCH-08 RWO constraint)
safe_scope_determination.rationale: Committed manifests target local-path; repo lacks RWX provisioner; Option 1 eliminates root vulnerability immediately without breaking local dev or modifying application logic.

implementation_bounds.cont_08: Remediated via pod-level fsGroup: 1000 and removal of root init-uploads
implementation_bounds.arch_08: Deliberate RWO architectural constraint; worker co-located on ai-service node via podAffinity
implementation_bounds.deployment_model: Supports local-development model (k3s, Rancher Desktop, kind)
implementation_bounds.future_work: Cloud-scale multi-node storage (RWX / S3) deferred to post-Phase 13 roadmap
